description: This file defines a PHP class 'ArrayCollectionModel' that implements a 'CollectionNormalizable' interface. It encapsulates an array of data and provides a method to return this data as an array.

classes.name: ArrayCollectionModel
classes.description: A model representing a collection of data that can be normalized into an array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an array of data.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the encapsulated data as an array.
